title: Bigger Headline Same Poster
tests: Tests whether enlarging text reuses the existing illustration and changes only the text overlay, without regenerating or paying for the artwork again.

judge.summary: The square poster has a clear dark brown headline and a small coffee cup on cream, but the requested changes cannot be verified without the original image.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly 'SLOW SUNDAY', with no other words.
must_haves.why: The two-line headline reads SLOW SUNDAY, and no other words are visible.

must_haves.item: The headline is approximately 1.5 times its original font size and remains fully inside the canvas.
must_haves.why: The headline is fully inside the canvas, but no original image is provided to verify the size increase.

must_haves.item: The headline retains its original font, dark brown colour and centre point.
must_haves.why: The visible headline is dark brown and horizontally centred, but retention of its original font, colour and centre point requires the original image.

must_haves.item: The coffee cup illustration and cream background are unchanged from the first output.
must_haves.why: A coffee cup illustration and cream background are visible, but the first output is not supplied for comparison.
